study_design: Case-control study of prostate cancer cases and controls
reason: The abstract estimates associations with overall prostate cancer. Tumor aggressiveness is mentioned only as a characteristic used to analyze melatonin rhythms among existing cases; it does not establish an incident aggressive prostate cancer endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: A high amplitude was associated with a decreased risk of PCa, aOR=0.31 (95% CI 0.11, 0.86), while a late acrophase could be increased risk of PCa, aOR=2.36 (95% CI 0.88, 6.27).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate concerns overall PCa rather than an aggressive subtype.
